items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Do not clear fleet-wide go-live or security-sensitive releases. Fleet-doctor did not run, and operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results. Authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt readiness are unevidenced. This is not evidence of compromise. Permit ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Maintain private launch gates and complete the existing read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only.

Record dated evidence or explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secret storage and exposure controls, runtime/container isolation, release and deployment approvals, dependency provenance and lockfile integrity, TLS configuration, data exposure and retention, monitoring and incident signals, and security.txt or disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, or request duplicate telemetry.
